title: Slay the Spire 2 beta v0.113.0 adds The Fool, Blitz and Dread

sources.note: Mega Crit Steam announcement, Beta Patch Notes v0.113.0, 12 Nov 2026 20:30Z: new character The Fool (bow-wielding musician), new modes Blitz and Dread, beta branch only; main branch gets v0.111.0 content

first_report: 2026-11-12 20:30Z Steam announcement (00:30 Dubai 13 Nov); under 24 h

angle.hook: Slay the Spire 2 gets its first new character, The Fool, and two new modes
angle.what_it_means_here: beta branch only; Blitz is a short chaotic mode, Dread a brutal one unlocked at Ascension 10 on all characters
angle.payoff: to test it, opt in to the public-beta branch on Steam

footage: official Steam trailers (appid 2868840): Gameplay Trailer and Early Access Trailer, their own sound
